acceptanceRuleChanges.scope: Every batch opened after R132 (open_revision.py --new-batch sets protectedSet goport). The protected set is goport's own evidence: every goport test name (docs/goport-protected/tests-r131.json.gz, then the results of the last accepted goport revision), every gate item against the last accepted gate manifest, every gate run of the source (gateRuns; a failed run needs a flake note for each regression), the bound Query and Hono runs, the LSP oracle (6 batteries) and API oracle (10 batteries) per request, np-suite, quality and both verdicts. A cap only goes down; only Theo can raise one. A lost, absent or unrun base pass is STOP; new passes do not compensate. The legacy cargo roster (6,055 and 6,330 names), the roster drive, the current-source corpus and the roster carry-forward are retired for new batches; R132 (batch port-18, opened under them before this rule) is the last revision under them. For goport batches this replaces the 'Protected cargo roster' clause of pin-bump-batch. Old batches keep their rules. Root must not widen it. Gate tools: every tool hash in the gate manifest (oracle, Go dumper, gate.sh, allow list, stage scripts, saved Go output families in oracleCaches) must equal the base run's, unless batch.gateToolChanges lists the exact change for the reviewer.
